Accomplishment
1. Well-Know Writer for Writing Stories about the lives of the Taiwanese Americans.

2. Published A Hanji Book, A Collection of Her Articles Posted in Newspapers, Magazines, and Newsletters of T. A. Organizations.

3. Director of The International Fine Arts College Library/Miami/Florida for 12 Years.

4. Retail Store Owner of Oriental Furniture in Miami/Florida for 12 Years.

5. Raised Two Outstanding Daughters Who Are Honored as Outstanding Taiwanese Americans by T. A. Archives.

6. Support Her husband who Was An Outstanding Professor at Florida International University for 40 Years and Is Honored as An Outstanding Taiwanese American by T. A. Archives.

7. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 03/2019

Notable Accomplishments

Well-known writer for writing stories about the lives of Taiwanese Americans.

Published a Hanji book, a collection of her articles posted in newspapers, magazines, and newsletters of Taiwanese American organizations.

Director of the International Fine Arts College Library, Miami, Florida for 12 years.

Retail store owner of Oriental Furniture in Miami, Florida for 12 years.

Raised two outstanding daughters honored as Outstanding Taiwanese Americans by T.A. Archives.

Outstanding Taiwanese American elected by T.A. Archives in March 2019.
